cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

mechanism: A imitates game-packup motions as supposed further play so B must complete another step before leaving.
confusable: S04 misreads confident behavior; a knowingly competent host merely delaying is insufficient.
comparison: Shared game ignorance contrasts with class etiquette.
seedUse: Use D02-b converting B's escape solution into another reason to remain.
